# OpenCodeServer

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.OpenCode` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/OpenCode/OpenCodeServer.cs#L22)

Owns the headless `opencode serve`process that the chat window talks to.
The process deliberately outlives domain reloads. Starting it costs a couple of seconds and
every recompile would otherwise drop the running agent mid-turn, so the port and process id
are parked in [`SessionState`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/SessionState.html) - which survives a reload but not an editor
restart - and we reattach to the already running server afterwards. The flip side is that a
hard editor crash can orphan the process, so a stale id found at startup is killed before a
new server is spawned.
